categories.evidence: Changes 5 lines in src/util/fs.h solely to support wallet database staging.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Wallet label and changes primarily in src/wallet/wallet.cpp and walletdb files.
categories.rationale: Prevents premature deletion of legacy wallet databases during SQLite migration and handles mid-flight exceptions cleanly. As noted in commit ba250143c4, migration previously removed the original BerkeleyDB database before verifying that the SQLite database was fully written, forcing manual recovery from backups if writing failed.
